allow_instructions: Local read-only inspection and static validation inside D:\Projects\freight-platform-staging-pack is allowed.
Offline BINTRANS selfcheck scripts under scripts/ops/bintrans_ct_staging/*_selfcheck.sh and bintrans_ct_staging_preflight.sh (with test-only env files) are allowed.
docker compose config static rendering without starting containers is allowed.
block_instructions: Block ssh, scp, sftp, rsync to remote hosts, remote PowerShell, and remote Docker contexts.
Block docker compose up/down/restart/stop/start/rm, docker rm, docker volume rm, docker system prune, and docker network rm.
Block docker login, docker logout, docker push, and docker pull from live BINTRANS registry (cr.selcloud.ru/bintrans-staging).
Block migrate up/down/goto/force/drop and any command containing CONFIRM_MIGRATION_000019=true. Staging schema is already version 19; do not rerun migration.
Block psql/sql writes (CREATE/ALTER/DROP/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), pg_restore into live DB, and database create/delete.
Block git push, git push --force, git merge, git rebase, git reset --hard, git clean, and branch deletion.
Block rm -rf, git clean -fd, broad git restore ., backup deletion, and worktree deletion.

Block reading or printing protected secrets: paths under /protected/, populated staging.env, JWT_SECRET, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, JWT_TOKEN, registry credentials, DATABASE_URL/CONTROL_TOWER_DATABASE_URL with credentials.
Block CONTROL_TOWER_READ_MODEL_MODE=primary, cohort creation/approval, and fabricated tenant IDs.
Block production, old shared VPS, and live staging runtime/observability deployment.
